draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: On the unseen test sets of the Banking and Travel domains, Wrenfold achieves higher macro-F1 than Fennick-Base (93.1 vs 91.6 and 92.4 vs 90.9).
rationale: The evidence only covers the unseen test sets of the two trained domains (Banking, Travel). No other customer-service domains were evaluated, so generalization to "domains not seen in training" is unsupported. The supported claim is the advantage on the unseen test sets of the evaluated domains.
